whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Gamers Hub Patna,

I noticed your gaming lounge has stellar 4.9★ reviews at RPS More in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for tournament registrations and hourly booking inquiries.

Maine aapke gaming lounge ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp slot booking, gaming console/PC lineup, aur pricing packages integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/gamershub

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
Hi Team Gamers Hub Patna, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Gamers Hub Patna) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha.

Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya?

*(If they checked it)*: Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp slot booking and your 4.9★ reviews showcase at RPS More in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?

*(If they haven't checked yet)*: No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai, just wanted to share the idea and get your feedback.

Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
